promptAsSent:
Use the image_gen tool to generate exactly one image, then stop. Do not write files, run commands or edit anything.

Attached reference images, in order:
Image 1: Image 1: rail language, perspective and material only
Image 2: Image 2: a larger sibling, scale reference only; this weapon is distinct

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-source concept for one modular top-down tactical-game mech ARM weapon sprite
Primary request: a heavy BURST pulse laser for a mech arm, the big capacitor-fed laser that fires four rapid pulses and then must vent: one thick central focusing barrel flanked by two thin outer rails, with a long armored capacitor housing along the rear carrying a row of stacked cooling plates and a heat-vent grille, and red-orange charge lamps down both flanks. It is the largest laser in the family: roughly 115 percent of Image 1's width and 125 percent of its length. Image 1 supplies rail language, perspective and material only; Image 2 is a larger sibling for scale, this one is bulkier, with a vent grille and a single thick barrel.
Critical perspective: strict 90-degree zenith orthographic top-down view. The camera looks straight down at the TOP surfaces of the weapon. The weapon fires horizontally toward the NORTH/TOP edge of the canvas, parallel to the battlefield plane. The muzzle faces AWAY from the camera, so the camera cannot see a circular bore, aperture face, dish, lens, or glowing front surface. At the extreme northmost tip show only very thin, almost edge-on dark exit slits between long north-south barrel or focusing rails. Keep every optical path narrow, recessed and mostly dark; do not use a broad glowing window on the top face.
Style/medium: crisp high-resolution painted game sprite matching the existing modular mech weapon family (Image 1): fine surface noise, panel seams, fasteners, restrained wear, upper-left baked object lighting, neutral olive-drab painted composite casing, dark gunmetal mechanisms, small restrained red-orange indicator lamps (energy hardware in this game is red-orange, not cyan), small amber service lamps. Composition/framing: exactly one isolated vertical module centred with generous padding on a flat featureless pure white isolation plate (no gradient, shadow, halo, floor, border or checkerboard). Symmetrical enough to mirror to either side, with a short rear mounting tab or plate that disappears beneath a mech chassis.
Avoid: visible circular muzzle, upward-pointing barrel, perspective, isometric, side view, multiple objects, hands, mech body, vehicle, turret base, text, logo, watermark, cropping.
